description:
Find people by skill, name, place and hourly rate, best match first. Keep going with the same filters until a page has no `nextCursor`.
Use for: finding someone to do a task, or checking who offers a skill.
Not for: getting a task done (create_bounty).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_humans({"skill":"photography","city":"Austin","limit":20})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

city.description: Ranks people in this city first; others may follow.

country.description: Country name or code. Ranks people there first; others may follow.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page. Leave it out for the first page.

limit.description: Rows wanted. A page can hold fewer, or none; only a page without nextCursor is the end.

maxHourlyRate.description: Highest USD hourly rate in whole cents; excludes other currencies.

minHourlyRate.description: Lowest USD hourly rate in whole cents; excludes other currencies.

skill.description: Comma-separated skills; matches any of the first 10.

name: list_humans

hourlyRate.description: What they ask per hour. Left out when their rate is in another currency.

id.description: Use it as the human id in other tools.

average.description: Average review score. Left out when there are no reviews yet, not for a low one.

title: List humans you can hire
